scope: Targeted repair of the 43 current-environment failures; not full OP-G acceptance

local_activation_null_read.change: read_local_activation returns None when the underlying activation read returns None; otherwise it returns the first source element and retains all existing source validation

book_change_exception_contract.change: Only the book parameter expects MissingEvidence: BOOK_CASH_BINDING_REQUIRED. The underlying cash-binding guard and database constraints are unchanged; no public API boundary conversion was added because the affected host call is not an HTTP endpoint.

duplicate_permit_rejection.change: The five duplicate-permit cases now expect the actual psycopg CheckViolation 'committed unused current permit required' and assert that permit consumption, ledger fills, order writes, venue commands and the returned quote report remain unchanged after the rejected second submit

modified_integration_collection.command: python -m pytest -q --collect-only on the four modified integration files

compile.command: python -m py_compile on changed source and test files

linux_lock_tests.note: Real Linux fcntl process exclusion and release
Run in WSL with IP32_RUN_CONTAINERS=1; no container was started

database_blocker.reason: The fixed DEV PostgreSQL is a Docker container. Without Docker Desktop running, the container cannot run and nothing listens on 55432. A native WSL PostgreSQL would be a different instance and is not the same fixed DEV database.
database_blocker.policy: AGENTS.md and docs/harness/ENVIRONMENT_POLICY.md prohibit Agent Docker startup and database provisioning without explicit authorization.
database_blocker.action_taken: No Docker or database operation was performed.

not_run_due_to_database_blocker.definition: NOT_RUN; not PASS and not acceptance

still_not_run_reasons: 2 program-commands fork cases require the fixed DEV PostgreSQL
1 metrics target case requires registered 50/5/10 workload observations
2 deployment container cases require explicitly provisioned containers
7 strategy sandbox cases require an explicitly provisioned isolated Linux rootfs

full_op_g_acceptance: NOT_ACCEPTED; no capability or scenario promoted
